senses.gloss: (b. h.; √בך, v. בכי, cmp. בָּקַר) [to break forth,] to be early. [Kal prob. not used.]
to be early, produce first fruits. Tanḥ. Vayḥi 14; Gen. R. s. 99 מְבַכֶּרֶת (פירותיה) has early crops, opp. מלקשת, מאפלת. [Ib. end מבכרין מפירותיהם read מכבדין, v. כָּבַד.]
to bear for the first time (of animals).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 1:3">Bekh. I, 3</cite> sq. <he>שלא בִיכְּרָה</he> that never before had given birth; a. fr.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bikkurim 3:1">Bicc. III, 1</cite> and sees <he>תאנה שבִּכְּרָה</he> a fig which is first ripe, <he>אשכול שביכר</he> a cluster of grapes which &c. Y. Maasr. I, 49ᵃ top <he>משיְבַכֵּר צמייא וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="R00577"><he>צמייא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 3:2">Bekh. III, 2</cite> <he>המַבְכִּירוֹת</he> those animals which have given birth for the first time.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 161:3">Yalk. Gen. 161</cite> <he>שהיא מִתְבַּכֶּרֶת בפירותיה</he>, v. supra.
